scope: Uncommitted runtime snapshot captured before owner fixes; no source changes by reviewer.

findings.title: Final backup manifest precedes freeze cleanup
findings.evidence: Source inspection: payload written and directory synced before exiting frozen_db. Phase-two close failure can leave manifest. Owner independently identified issue and has reported a fix; exact final candidate not yet verified.

findings.title: Unconditional rollback replaces primary error
findings.evidence: Two independent adversarial controls inject a primary ValueError then rollback OSError; both return rollback failure rather than primary error, with no notes. Process remains held.

findings.title: Caught cursor-close failure permits successful owner exit
findings.evidence: Independent control catches cursor-close OSError in owned read body. Connection closes, __exit__ returns success with held=True. Owner must refuse successful exit when its cleanup became unconfirmed.

targeted_controls.error_class: Known preliminary test harness: mock connect positional uri parameter conflicts with sqlite3.connect(uri=True). Preserved, not treated as runtime failure.
